portsSource.from: Extron XTP Systems Engineering Drawings/-XTP - Receivers Eng.vssx
portsSource.label: XTP R HD 4K

ports.label: XTP In
ports.notes: Shielded CATx (RJ-45) carrying HDMI/audio/Ethernet/RS-232/IR from an XTP CrossPoint output board. Powered remotely over the same CATx.

ports.label: Audio Out
ports.notes: 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw, stereo balanced/unbalanced. De-embedded from HDMI or XTP.

ports.label: S/PDIF Out
ports.notes: Coaxial S/PDIF digital audio output (de-embedded from HDMI).

ports.label: RS-232/IR
ports.notes: 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw (3 pins used). Host SIS control + IR pass-through pins on same connector. (RS-232 and IR on one connector; 5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: Relay 1
ports.notes: 2-pole 3.5mm captive screw — dry-contact relay output for room control (24V/1A typical). (2-pole captive screw)

ports.label: Relay 2
ports.notes: 2-pole 3.5mm captive screw — dry-contact relay output for room control (24V/1A typical). (2-pole captive screw)

ports.label: Power
ports.notes: External 12VDC Extron Everlast PSU brick (100-240 VAC universal input). Endpoint also supports remote power over XTP.
